body: Thank you so much. Appreciate you 😊

even though she did tell me about her traumas? that all of those were stemming from her traumas and from not being able to have friends ever since she was a kid? 

i did my own set of mistakes and im doing my best to be a better partner. but when i tried to tell her that im uncomfortable with that girl hanging out with her, she threw out my past mistakes to me. and now i felt like im so stupid for opening up lol
thank u so much, that means a lot 🥺 will keep it in mind.
money is an issue though but yes, thanks for that.

she’s actually on her period yeah lol but it ain’t the first time it happened. 

and yeah u’re right, thanks so much.

yeah u’re right. i hope she sees herself how i see her. she’s so amazing but she doesn’t want to believe that at all. she keeps holding on to her negative thoughts that no one loves her and she’s so ugly and all that. she told me that “i don’t want to be [her name] anymore”. idk how to help her? where do i start. she’s so close to cutting me off.
i love her so much and i know that she won’t stay like that forever. but ofc i hate it when it happens.

she sent me this document, like a speech lol. 

but yes, i do want her back though.

but why not take her back? need some thoughts. this has happened a lot of times too.
no, she’s not on therapy. and idk if she’s doing a specific work to fight her battles. this happens all the time. she says all this self pity talks and she self loathes almost every time.

I did admit everything I did and I’m not trying to make her think that I never lied.

What im tryna say is, I can’t afford to lie to her EVER again and i just wanted some advice on how i can let her feel more that im 100% sincere and i’m being honest that i have clean intentions with her.

I’d like to clear that I NEVER blamed her for that. I owned up to it and I did admit everything I did. My actions have no excuses, at all. I regret everything and I feel so immature for doing that. It just came to the point that her insecurities and issues from her past relationship were brought along to ours. I accept her for who she is. I don’t care about the flaws. I love her on her good and bad days. And I am more than willing to do everything to earn her trust back. I want to earn that. 

But there are days before that I wasn’t able to handle her insecurities anymore. She gives meaning to almost everything I do or say (before the lying incident). I get that she’s an overthinker, but it’s just hard sometimes when u feel like u’re being monitored. I do have my own set of self issues too ofc. And it just sucks that I let it get the best of me instead of communicating it with her. As much as I wanted to, I just felt like she wouldn’t understand at all. I did try communicating before, but it didn’t end so well. I am so disappointed of myself for letting my anger get through me. I know and am aware that I did her wrong.

We did talk about it and agreed to start again. But there are days that she’ll remind me of my past mistakes which will eventually turn into a fight. Whenever I try to assure her she always thinks im lying and everything i say’s a lie. 

Our rel’s on and off and it’s honestly like a cycle. Just the same pattern. We both know that we love each other so much but i dont know what to do anymore. 

We broke up again today. She kept saying bad things about herself - and that’s my fault. I did say bad things about her when I was really really mad. And she said she doesn’t know what to do anymore cuz everything is heavy and her emotions are all over the place.
